casiopea-constel-desc: con§tel: active reading and a collective concept map. Readers select sections (§), code them with shared concepts and synthesise their own themes.
right-constel-annotate: Create and code sections (§), and keep themes and their development in con§tel
right-constel-moderate: Moderate the shared con§tel vocabulary (rename and merge concepts, delete other readers' sections)
constel-form-concept-placeholder: Type or choose; comma for another
constel-form-public-notice: Your sections, concepts and themes are public: anyone visiting the wiki can see them, with your username.
constel-error-generic: It could not be saved. Please try again.
constellation-svg-invalid: There is no map to download. Use the download button on [[Special:Constellation]].
constellation-summary: The constellation of concepts contributed by every reader of the wiki. Concepts are linked when a reader coded them in the same section (§); dashed, when sections by different readers overlap; dotted and faint, when they were annotated on the same page. Choose a concept to see its sections.
constellation-empty: There are no concepts yet. Select a section on any page and press § to add the first one.
constellation-graph-label: Concept map: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|concept|concepts}}. Drag a concept (or use Alt+arrow keys on it) to move it.
constellation-no-themes: This reader has no themes yet.
constellation-in-no-theme: No reader has grouped it in a theme yet.
constellation-group-into: Group into one of my themes
constellation-theme-empty: No concepts yet: open one on the map and group it here.
constellation-theme-name: Theme name “$1” (edit to rename; Enter saves, Esc cancels)
constellation-theme-delete-confirm: Delete this theme and its development? Its concepts stay on the map.
myconstel-summary: All your sections (§), including the lost ones: those whose text changed and could no longer be located. You can export them to open in the standalone con§tel.
myconstel-needlogin: You need a registered account to have your own con§tel reading.
myconstel-empty: You have no sections yet. Select text on a page and press §.
log-description-constel: Moderation of the shared con§tel vocabulary: renamed and merged concepts, and sections (§) deleted by moderators.
constellation-merge-confirm: Merge "$1" into "$2"? Its sections and theme groupings move to "$2", and "$1" disappears.
constellation-merge-unknown: There is no concept "$1". Choose an existing one.
constel-minimap-label: Map of the sections on this page
constel-form-gloss-placeholder: A comment or clarification on this section
constel-pref-enabled: Use con§tel on pages: § when selecting text, section marks and reading controls
constel-pref-enabled-help: Off by default. When on, you can select text on any content page and press § to annotate it with concepts and a gloss; your reading is public. When off, pages look as if con§tel were not installed; the constellation and your own list stay available in Special pages.
constellation-graph-label-3d: Concept map in 3D: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|concept|concepts}}. Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate.
constellation-divider: Divider between the map and the panel (drag or use the arrow keys)
constellation-concept-name: Concept name “$1” (edit to rename it for everyone; Enter saves, Esc cancels)
constellation-unpin: Back to the automatic layout (releases the concepts you moved)
